commands.name: run
commands.summary: Run the declared flows across the matrix and write report/report.json with its findings, evidence and summary. Exit 1 when a check named by failOn fails.

out.description: Where the report is written (default report).

shard.description: k/n: run one shard of the units.

fail-on.description: any, none, or a comma list of checks that fail the run (default any).

only.description: A comma list of checks to run (default all).

times.description: The per-unit times that balance the shards.

workers.description: Matrix cells run side by side in one browser.

cells.description: A comma list of cell key texts to keep, for a quick local run.

engine.description: Browser engines every web flow runs on: chromium, webkit, msedge.

target.description: What the flows run against, recorded in report.json's provenance.

target-version.description: The target's version, recorded in provenance.

headed.description: Show the browser; refused outside CI.

evidence-max.description: The most evidence to keep: bytes, KB, MB or none.

constrained.description: Slow every page through DevTools, or off.

known-failing.description: The list of cells that fail today, each with its issue.

commands.name: list
commands.summary: Print every unit the flows expand to and how shards split them. Runs nothing.

times.description: The per-unit times that balance the shards.

commands.name: merge
commands.summary: Combine shard report folders into one report.json, checking that each expected unit ran exactly once. Exit 3 when a failing unit is missing or ran twice.

out.description: Where the merged report is written (default report).

flows.description: A glob of the flows whose units are expected.

fail-on.description: any, none, or a comma list of checks.

known-failing.description: The list of cells that fail today.

commands.name: times
commands.summary: Write each unit's measured time from the report folders to the times file, which the next run uses to balance shards.

out.description: Where the times are written (default flows/flow-review-times.json).

commands.name: summary
commands.summary: Print the markdown summary of report/report.json.

commands.name: judge
commands.summary: Validate the judges' rubric answer files and fold them into report.json. Exit 2 when one is invalid.

merge.description: Fold the rubric answer files named after it into the report.

report.description: The report folder to update (default report).

commands.name: known-failing
commands.summary: Check a known-failing list is valid. With base, exit 1 when it grew against the base list: the list only shrinks.

base.description: The base branch's list to compare against.

count.description: Print how many entries the list has.

commands.name: validate
commands.summary: Load and validate the flows named by the globs, printing one ok line per flow. Runs nothing.
